name: kalastria_highborn_target_player_never_designated
notes: KNOWN BUG, fails today (M5 mapper, 2026-11-17). Run it on the FDN record with `cardtool.py runpack FDN <this pack>` (tools/run_scenarios.py plays verified trees only). Printed: 'Whenever this creature or another Vampire you control dies, you may pay {B}. If you do, target player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.' The record writes 'target player' as LOSE_LIFE(controller=TARGET_PLAYER), the canonical form (Sublime Epiphany's 'Target player draws a card'). In a dies trigger the binder pre-binds a designated player with no TARGET Selector to the dead creature (binding.TriggerBinder._put, Massacre Wurm's 'that player' anaphora, D18), so the target is never asked: it is the dying Vampire's controller, seat 0, who loses 2 and gains 2. Weaker than printed (one legal choice of the printed card, forced). Expected once fixed: seat 0's Vampire dies; the trigger targets seat 1 as it goes on the stack; seat 0 pays {B}: seat 1 loses 2, seat 0 gains 2.
